label: Potential flooding (permanent water excluded)
limitation: Water outside the permanent-water reference is potential flooding; seasonal water and reference gaps can remain. A verified pre-event water map is needed to confirm newly flooded areas.

evaluation.label_definition: All event water, including permanent water. No independently verified newly flooded labels.
evaluation.selection: Original model retained after two failed retrospective release checks. Official chip splits share events; independent event-level generalization remains unverified.

validation.label_definition: Hand-labeled event water, including permanent water. Outside-permanent water is a proxy, not confirmed newly flooded ground truth.
validation.imagery_description: Sentinel-1 event VV radar, grayscale using fixed training clipping limits; dark pixels indicate low backscatter, not necessarily flooding.
validation.permanent_water_source: Sen1Floods11 published JRCWaterHand reference; historical window unspecified. Empty reference does not establish absence of permanent water.

source: Sen1Floods11 v1.1 hand-labeled Pakistan test chip; recorded inference from the bundled model
example_note: Recorded model prediction selected to show a visible overlay. This is not current flooding or an accuracy benchmark; permanent-water filtering does not confirm new inundation.
